text:
maya: Heads-up — several PRs hit the eval PR gate and GH Actions jobs sat in "queued" for ~15-25m earlier. Anyone else seeing long runner wait times?
oscar: yep saw it, looked like a spike around the nightly window. :thinking:
june: CI dashboard shows runner_pool_autoscale thrashing around 03:12 UTC, spikes in queued_jobs for label=eval-runner.
ci-bot: build queued: gha-eval-pr #412 by @sophia (runner: self-hosted-linux, label: eval-large)
tomas: pasted the runner-manager logs I grabbed — token refresh / attach timeouts.
```
2026-03-19T03:12:01Z runner-manager INFO provisioning request for 6 runners
2026-03-19T03:12:05Z auth-proxy WARN token refresh slow (500ms)
2026-03-19T03:12:20Z runner-manager ERROR failed to attach runner: timeout after 20s
```
maya: sigh. PRs with heavy eval matrices (quant + 3 seeds + long sequences) hog self-hosted slots for ages.
kevin: short-term workaround: reduce PR matrix or add a lightweight smoke job that runs in <2m. Full evals go to nightly. We can also gate by label.
oscar: fwiw infra flipped the GH Actions autoscale policy last week to `batch_provision = true` which can add attach delay for single runners — I suspect it's related. Investigating.
june: metric: grafana panel `gh-actions-runner-queue-latency` shows 95p jump from ~12s -> 620s during the window. Our alert didn't fire because threshold is 300s and exporter scrapes every 5m.
tomas: suggestion: add jitter to PR eval dispatch so PR jobs don't align with nightly cron. Small random offset avoids thundering herd.
maya: can we just move heavy evals to Buildkite ephemeral fleet? We have spare capacity for burst and it's better at long-running matrices.
kevin: yes — two practical paths: 1) keep GHA as gate but have it trigger Buildkite (GHA job triggers a BK pipeline and waits for Checks API status), 2) switch gating logic to an external checker (checks API consumer) that observes BK. Option 1 is lower lift.
oscar: another quick fix: default PR runs should be a trimmed matrix unless the PR has `full-eval` label. Authors can opt-in.
june: also found a runner auth-refresh bug: k8s service-account token rotation delays runner-manager restart. I'll open a small PR to restart the manager pod on token expiry and add better logs.
ci-bot: deploy event: runner-manager v1.14.2 rolled at 03:40 UTC by @infra-bot
maya: if someone sketches the minimal GH workflow change I can open the PR today.
tomas: sketch for .github/workflows/eval.yml: 
```
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  quick-eval:
    if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'quick-eval') || !startsWith(github.head_ref, 'dependabot/')
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps: ...
  full-eval:
    if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-eval')
    runs-on: buildkite-trigger
```
kevin: :thumbsup: also add help text in PR template so authors know how to request full runs.
maya: I'll do the GH workflow change + PR template update.
kevin: can we also tighten alerts? Set a per-minute scrape for the queue metric and add runbook steps: if queue > 20 and scaling lag > 2m -> restart manager pod & page infra oncall.
june: on it, will raise the alert tweak and add the runbook.
oscar: tl;dr: immediate = label gating + alert tweak; medium = k8s token fix; long = move heavy matrices off GHA or use remote runner pool.
maya: thanks folks — I'll open the PR and post links here when ready. :raised_hands:
